text: Three hours from now, this address will be live on the internet. Your name. Your work. Built by talking, not by coding.
Most portfolios are built once, on an app builder. They look fine, and then they never change. That's a sandcastle. Today, we build a house: one you keep adding rooms to.

Here's the plan. One: write your idea on one page. Two: let Claude interview you, and research for you. Three: turn it into three short documents. Four: build it with Claude Code, one phase at a time. And five: push to GitHub, deploy on Cloudflare, and connect your own domain.
What do you need? A laptop. A free GitHub account. And a folder of your stuff: photos, projects, a few lines about you. Plus curiosity. Ask questions. Break things.
In three hours, you walk out with a live site on your own domain, a prompt pack, ready templates, and a way to make it better every single day.
This isn't theory. With the same method, I built my own site, a visiting card with five themes, the Vetal Tekdi birding marathon, RunFolio, and a data story on pumped storage.
So what's the limit? Not code. Not tools. Only your imagination. So let it fly. Let's begin!
